#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>
#include <sstream>
#include <cassert>

class InputReader {
public:
    std::stringstream tokenizer;
    std::string buffer;

    int nextInt() {
        std::string token;
        while (!(token >> token)) {
            if (!std::getline(std::cin, buffer))
                throw std::runtime_error("No more input");
            tokenizer.clear();
            tokenizer.str(buffer);
        }
        return std::stoi(token);
    }
};

class IntStack {
public:
    std::vector<long long> array;
    int size = 0;

    IntStack() {
        array.reserve(8);
    }

    void add(long long i) {
        push(i);
    }

    int get(int i) {
        return array[i];
    }

    void push(long long item) {
        if (size >= (int)array.size())
            resize();
        if (size < (int)array.size())
            array[size] = item;
        else
            array.push_back(item);
        ++size;
    }

    int getSize() const {
        return size;
    }

private:
    void resize() {
        size_t newCapacity = std::max<size_t>(array.size() * 2, 1);
        array.resize(newCapacity);
    }
};

class NumberTheory {
public:
    class Modulus {
    protected:
        IntStack factorial;
        IntStack invFactorial;

        virtual long long modulus() const = 0;

    public:
        Modulus() {
            factorial.add(1LL);
            invFactorial.add(1LL);
        }

        long long fact(int n) {
            while (factorial.getSize() <= n) {
                factorial.add(mult(factorial.get(factorial.getSize() - 1), factorial.getSize()));
            }
            return factorial.get(n);
        }

        long long fInv(int n) {
            int lastKnown = invFactorial.getSize() - 1;
            if (lastKnown < n) {
                std::vector<long long> fInv(n - lastKnown);
                fInv[0] = inv(fact(n));
                for (int i = 1; i < (int)fInv.size(); ++i) {
                    fInv[i] = mult(fInv[i - 1], n - i + 1);
                }
                for (int i = (int)fInv.size() - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
                    invFactorial.add(fInv[i]);
                }
            }
            return invFactorial.get(n);
        }

        long long ncr(int n, int r) {
            assert(n >= 0);
            if (r < 0 || n < r)
                return 0;
            return mult(fact(n), mult(fInv(r), fInv(n - r)));
        }

        long long smallInv(int n) {
            return mult(fInv(n), fact(n - 1));
        }

        long long normalize(long long x) {
            long long m = modulus();
            x %= m;
            if (x < 0) x += m;
            return x;
        }

        long long add(long long a, long long b) {
            long long v = a + b;
            long long m = modulus();
            return v < m ? v : v - m;
        }

        long long subtract(long long a, long long b) {
            long long v = a - b;
            long long m = modulus();
            return v < 0 ? v + m : v;
        }

        long long mult(long long a, long long b) {
            return (a * b) % modulus();
        }

        long long mult(long long a, long long b, long long c) {
            return mult(mult(a, b), c);
        }

        long long mult(const std::vector<long long>& x) {
            long long r = 1;
            for (long long i : x)
                r = mult(r, i);
            return r;
        }

        long long inv(long long value) {
            long long g = modulus(), x = 0, y = 1;
            for (long long r = value; r != 0; ) {
                long long q = g / r;
                g %= r;

                long long temp = g;
                g = r;
                r = temp;

                x -= q * y;

                temp = x;
                x = y;
                y = temp;
            }

            assert(g == 1);
            assert(y == modulus() || y == -modulus());

            return normalize(x);
        }
    };

    class Mod998 : public Modulus {
    protected:
        long long modulus() const override {
            return 998244353LL;
        }
    };
};

class HZSShufflesCards {
private:
    NumberTheory::Mod998 mod;
    int n;
    int m;
public:
    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, std::ostream& out) {
        n = in.nextInt();
        m = in.nextInt();

        mod.fInv(n + m);

        long long phaseSize = 1;
        long long p = 1;
        for (int i = 0; p != 0; ++i) {
            p = mult(p, n - i, mod.inv(n + m - i));
            phaseSize = mod.add(phaseSize, p);
        }

        long long answer = 0;
        for (int k = 1; k <= n; ++k) {
            long long numPhases = mult(m + k, mod.smallInv(k));
            long long e = mult(numPhases, phaseSize);
            long long term = mult(mod.ncr(n, k), e);
            if (k % 2 == 1)
                answer = mod.add(answer, term);
            else
                answer = mod.subtract(answer, term);
        }
        std::cout << answer << "\n";
    }

    long long mult(long long a, long long b) {
        return (a * b) % 998244353LL;
    }

    long long mult(long long a, long long b, long long c) {
        return ((a * b) % 998244353LL * c) % 998244353LL;
    }
};

int main() {
    InputReader in;
    HZSShufflesCards solver;
    solver.solve(1, in, std::cout);
    return 0;
}
